I have identified and resolved the issue causing proxy authentication failures (HTTP 407).

### Root Cause
When `urllib3.util.parse_url` was introduced to `requests.utils.prepend_scheme_if_needed`, `parsed.netloc` was used to reconstruct the target netloc without including `parsed.auth`. As a result, proxy URLs containing authentication credentials (e.g. `http://user:pass@proxy.com:8080`) had their user authentication stripped out, returning `http://proxy.com:8080`. When requests subsequently extracted credentials from the proxy URL, none were found, causing proxy authorization headers to be omitted and resulting in HTTP 407 status errors.

In addition:
- `get_auth_from_url` raised a `TypeError` when unquoting `None` passwords (e.g., `http://user@proxy.com`), falling back to `('', '')` instead of returning `('user', '')`.
- `Session.rebuild_proxies` checked `if username and password:` instead of `if username:` (unlike `HTTPAdapter.proxy_headers`), which stripped authorization headers when password was empty, and failed to look up host-specific or `all` proxy keys using `select_proxy`.

### Solution
1. **[`requests/utils.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j3oj_23p/requests/utils.py#L960-L1005)**:
   - Updated `prepend_scheme_if_needed` to re-attach `auth` to `netloc` when present (`'{0}@{1}'.format(auth, netloc)`).
   - Updated `get_auth_from_url` to check for `None` before unquoting `username` and `password`.
2. **[`requests/sessions.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j3oj_23p/requests/sessions.py#L284-L298)**:
   - Updated `rebuild_proxies` to use `select_proxy` for resolving proxy URLs and check `if username:` to handle empty passwords consistently with `HTTPAdapter`.
